## Overview

The notes service stores notes in SQLite, ranks search results by term overlap, and authenticates writes with signed bearer tokens.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  api --> store
  api --> auth
```

See `notes/store.py` for persistence and `auth/tokens.py` for signing.
